article.title: Can Socialists Govern a Capitalist State?
article.author: Max Elbaum
article.content: Since the 2016 combination of Donald Trump’s election and Bernie Sanders’s breakthrough campaign, efforts to synergize grassroots organizing with electoral engagement have become a priority for both longstanding and new radical formations.
